neil (sales): Heads-up: CedarBank POC call in 20m. They report inconsistent TTFT during demos (200ms typical, occasional 700-1500ms). Want an eng swarm.
sara (eng-runtime): Which model / pool? Any traces?
neil (sales): redwood-chat-std / cedar-demo-pool-us. They pasted a single trace showing batch_wait_ms ~210 and kv_misses high. Also saw some 429s during demo spike.
vik (eng-sre): Looking at infra: short autoscaler churn at 10:42 UTC and a KV shard rebalance right after. That explains kv_miss spikes and disk-backed fallback on a few pods. Queueing metrics show a spike in batch_hold_time (120-220ms) during the same window.
mika (solutions): For immediate customer guidance: 1) try prefill_tokens:2 in their client; 2) ask them to run the trace curl and share. Prefill reduces first-token overhead.
sara (eng-runtime): Operational fix we can try now: reduce batch_window_ms from 50->6 for cedar-demo-pool-us and set max_batch_size=10. Also pin min_replicas=2 to avoid autoscaler churn during the demo. I can flip now.
neil (sales): Please flip. They also asked if Dedicated would remove this; and what's the delta on pricing.
dylan (acct exec): Dedicated reduces noisy-neighbor rebalances and we can provide a 90-day trial at 10% off list + 5k demo credits. I'll DM exact numbers.
credits-bot: applied 5000 demo credits to cedarbank@example.com @ 1795550018
sara (eng-runtime): If Cedar can run this on their side, paste output so I can map requestId->pod logs:
```n curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"redwood-chat-std","input":"<sample>","trace":true}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/infer | jq .trace
```
That JSON includes batch_wait_ms, kv_hits/misses.
vik (eng-sre): Also adding a pod-warmup job to prepopulate KV for their top 40 prefixes during the rollout. That should kill cold-shard kv_misses.
mika (solutions): I'll attach our SOC2/KMS summary and the suggested prod config snippet to the support ticket.
neil (sales): Cedar pasted a trace snippet: {"req":"r-cd1","batch_wait_ms":211,"kv_hits":0,"kv_misses":6,"model_ms":31} 
sara (eng-runtime): Confirms pattern. After config change expect batch_wait_ms <30ms; kv_misses should drop after warmup job. If still high we can pin them to the quantized-small variant for the demo.
dylan (acct exec): If they sign Dedicated we'll include a warm-standby prewarm as part of onboarding (one-time).
neil (sales): Rolling changes now and will update Cedar on the call. Thanks all :thumbsup:
